headline: Ransomware Attack on NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. Highlights Cybersecurity Challenges
body: NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd., a leading supplier of automotive steering systems, has been hit by a ransomware attack that compromised its Windows domain infrastructure. This incident affected numerous devices and led to operational disruptions. The company, known for its innovative steering solutions, plays a crucial role in the automotive supply chain. With operations spanning several countries, NSK Steering Systems is a key partner to many automotive manufacturers. The attack underscores the importance of robust cybersecurity measures in protecting critical infrastructure from cyber threats. NSK Steering Systems is currently focused on restoring its systems and enhancing its cybersecurity framework to prevent future incidents. The company has engaged external cybersecurity experts to aid in the recovery process and is committed to maintaining the trust of its partners and clients.
